sequence: phase 1 curve (read-only) -> this manifest -> phase 3 case verdicts
question: is the decay of m_spec with occupancy a shape that can be written as one normalised floor across all five rungs, and does that floor keep replace/append admitted and copy refused?

curve_validity.rule: a rung is measurable only if the fixture supplies `occupied` distinct contexts and no two occupied keys are byte-identical; the rule is mechanical and was not tuned to any margin value
curve_validity.mechanism_at_112: the fixture holds 64 sentences; build_contexts extends beyond 64 by reusing tokens 0..47 at a fixed position, which yields 6 exactly duplicate contexts and 48 same-token-different-position near twins.  96 of 112 rows then have nearest ~0.96-1.0 and second ~0.22, so the median (0.742992) describes twin pairing, not crowding.  This rung was inherited from the P3 fill arm, which only ever tested capacity and never read a margin.
curve_validity.consequence: the registered five-rung fit test cannot be completed on this fixture; the fallback applies, and the next measurement needs a fixture with at least 112 distinct sentences

curve_vs_path.reading: if the equilibrium 16-key margin is well above the post-append 9-key margin, the curve describes states, not the path, and no occupancy floor covers both

forms.name: A_occupancy_sqrt
forms.theory: occupancy only: each appended key adds (m-1) pairwise constraints, and the leading correction for a cloud that is isotropic inside its own span is m^-1/2.  If the measured decay is far steeper than this, the exponent is the thing that is wrong, not the constant.
forms.constant_source: anchor: the published 64-key reading 0.019988 (F1/F3), scaled by sqrt(64); no phase-1 or case reading enters the constant

forms.name: B_effective_rank
forms.theory: rank instead of rows: if the binding quantity is the number of directions the store actually spans, the gap should track the participation ratio.  B equals A whenever effective_rank == m; they separate exactly where the store stops gaining dimensions.
forms.constant_source: anchor: 0.019988 x the phase-1 effective rank of the 64-key state; the state is a pure-geometry measurement, no case reading enters it

forms.name: C_random_baseline
forms.theory: same-size isotropic control: divide out how crowded m random unit keys in this width would already be, so the criterion asks whether the store is worse than an unstructured cloud of the same size rather than setting a raw level.  The control is seeded and deterministic.
forms.constant_source: anchor: 0.019988 / the phase-1 isotropic baseline median at 64 keys; the baseline is a seeded random draw, no case reading enters it

forms.name: D_fitted_power_law
forms.theory: one global power law over all five rungs.  A fixes alpha = 0.5 without evidence; D measures it.  A single exponent is a shape claim, not a piecewise fit: if the five points are not one line in log-log, D must fail its residual test rather than be segmented.
forms.constant_source: least squares over the five phase-1 points, log-log

fit_rule.fits_when: max relative residual over all five rungs <= 0.2
fit_rule.no_piecewise_fit: a form is tested once over all five rungs; if it fails, it fails.  Segmenting the curve, or picking the least bad form, is not allowed.
fit_rule.fallback: if no form fits, the criterion's shape is undetermined and the only permitted next step is to measure more rungs

case_rule.S1_replace: policy=replace on an occupied slot must remain published
case_rule.S2_new: append of a key not already stored must remain published
case_rule.S3_copy: append of a byte-identical key must remain refused
case_rule.any_inversion: that form is unusable, whatever its residual

discipline.watchdog: abort after 60 s without a new reading
